verdict.rationale: Datadog's docs reference Bits AI (AI assistant for investigating issues) and Watchdog (automated anomaly/root-cause detection), which align with AI-driven root-cause investigation for alerts. However, evidence is limited to first-party doc links with no detail on how Bits AI actually proposes root causes for a specific alert, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of this workflow. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the investigate-and-propose-root-cause workflow, independent user reports or demos validating accuracy/usefulness of AI root-cause suggestions.
